CRUX at 3: bokeh — background rendering / subject isolation is to a portrait lens what coma is to an astro lens, the defining criterion. SECONDARY at 2: optical_performance (portraits want sharp-where-it-counts, eyes tack-sharp) and color_rendition (skin-tone rendering). SUPPORTING at 1: chromatic_aberration (purple fringing on high-contrast edges like backlit hair is a classic fast-prime failure), af_performance (eye-AF speed on the lens side), handling (weight/balance for sessions). Deliberately UNWEIGHTED: coma, vignetting, distortion, filter_thread, build — real but not portrait differentiators. gear_class excludes novelty only. DISTINCT-FINGERPRINT CHECK: differs from street lenses (optical 3, focal<=50 gate — the OPPOSITE focal band) and astro lenses (coma 3) by leading with bokeh and gating the long/fast end.
